title: Output of the tip role
description: Either a tip (gist first) or an explicit skip ('facts or silence'). Structure is strict, lengths are generous: the diet length limits are measured and trimmed for display, not a reason to drop a tip.

why.description: 1-2 plain sentences of context the PM needs to build an answer (2026-11-05).
